::: {.project-detail}

::: {.project-hook}
Three years of club-level football with **Young Blue Elite FC** at the [Bengaluru FC Soccer School](https://www.instagram.com/bfcsoccerschools/?hl=en){target="_blank"} — competing across U17, U18, and U19 teams.
:::

## Overview

Football is as central to my identity as economics and code. Training and competing at Bengaluru FC's academy — one of India's top football development programmes — has shaped how I approach discipline, teamwork, and strategic thinking in every other domain of my life.

## What I Did

::: {.project-section}
<ul class="star-list">
<li><strong>Situation:</strong> I wanted to compete at the highest level of youth club football available in Bengaluru, balancing rigorous training with academic commitments.</li>
<li><strong>Task:</strong> Earn and maintain a place on BFC Soccer School teams across three age categories while continuing to excel in school.</li>
<li><strong>Action:</strong> Trained consistently with Young Blue Elite FC for three years; progressed through U17, U18, and U19 squads; applied tactical discipline and teamwork under competitive match conditions.</li>
<li><strong>Result:</strong> Sustained club-level representation at a premier academy — developing physical excellence, time management, and leadership skills that cross-pollinate into my academic and technical work.</li>
</ul>
:::
